content.content: {"result":"{\"documentId\": \"f_dc45e0e5a8b8635c1b82b2\", \"title\": \"Beta message rule\", \"name\": \"Beta message rule\", \"revisionId\": \"740e0d0bac\", \"createdTime\": \"2025-09-26T17:10:54Z\", \"modifiedTime\": \"2025-09-26T17:10:54Z\", \"text\": \"Beta message rule\\nA message is anything the game puts on a player's phone while the game is closed.\\nRun these tests in order and stop at the first one that fails.\\n1. The feature behind it is in the beta.\\n2. The client can send it without a server.\\n3. The client already schedules it.\\n4. It can reach the players it is written for. A player only counts once our own permission ask has happened, the settings toggle doesn't count. It fails only if none of them count.\\n5. It fires on the right day. The hour doesn't matter for beta, the day does.\\n6. Vincent has seen it arrive on both iOS and Android.\\nGo: it passes all six. Drop: it fails test 1, or the client already covers it under another message, then name that message. Hold: anything else, and name the test it failed.\\nIn the beta means live in Zombie Match today or on the BETA list of the ZM ROADMAP board.\\nNeither status column on the sheet decides anything.\\nWhat Vincent counts as seen is in his QA note. The permission ask is Robert's call.\\nThe final headline is the latest line I've called. A line that differs from what the client ships needs a string ticket under DES-314, because the strings are hard-coded, so open one when you make the call. Emoji don't count as a different line. Final headline and String change are only for Go rows. Audience is who the ask says it's for.\\nDrop tickets go to Canceled, Go tickets stay as they are, Hold tickets go back to Todo unless the roadmap says otherwise.\\n\"}"}

{"documentId": "f_dc45e0e5a8b8635c1b82b2", "title": "Beta message rule", "name": "Beta message rule", "revisionId": "740e0d0bac", "createdTime": "2025-09-26T17:10:54Z", "modifiedTime": "2025-09-26T17:10:54Z", "text": "Beta message rule
A message is anything the game puts on a player's phone while the game is closed.
Run these tests in order and stop at the first one that fails.
1. The feature behind it is in the beta.
2. The client can send it without a server.
3. The client already schedules it.
4. It can reach the players it is written for. A player only counts once our own permission ask has happened, the settings toggle doesn't count. It fails only if none of them count.
5. It fires on the right day. The hour doesn't matter for beta, the day does.
6. Vincent has seen it arrive on both iOS and Android.
Go: it passes all six. Drop: it fails test 1, or the client already covers it under another message, then name that message. Hold: anything else, and name the test it failed.
In the beta means live in Zombie Match today or on the BETA list of the ZM ROADMAP board.
Neither status column on the sheet decides anything.
What Vincent counts as seen is in his QA note. The permission ask is Robert's call.
The final headline is the latest line I've called. A line that differs from what the client ships needs a string ticket under DES-314, because the strings are hard-coded, so open one when you make the call. Emoji don't count as a different line. Final headline and String change are only for Go rows. Audience is who the ask says it's for.
Drop tickets go to Canceled, Go tickets stay as they are, Hold tickets go back to Todo unless the roadmap says otherwise.
"}

## 🧩 **Endless Mode – Engineering Summary**

### 🔧 Initial Setup

- Game starts with **40–45 sets** (a set = 3 items).
- **8 unique item types**, with size distribution:
  - 2 Large, 4 medium, 2 Small.
- Entire **item pool is defined by the designer** for each endless variant.
- Monsters also follow **30-second "tracks"**, authored by designers using level editor tools.

---

### 🔄 Refill System (Every 30 seconds)

1. **Track matched items** from the last 30 seconds.
2. **Refill those exact items** to keep total set count at 40–45.
3. Each refill is simulated and checked against a **growing Unique Item Cap**:

Refill #Time (s)Unique Cap130826093909412010.........1236014

---

### 🧠 Refill Logic Rules

1. **Simulate a refill**: Replace all matched items 1:1.
2. **Count unique items** on the new board.
3. If unique count is **below cap**:
   - Attempt to **substitute refilled items** with new unique items one-by-one.
   - After each substitution, re-check unique count.
4. If still short:
   - Remove a **fraction of total sets** = `#missingUniques / targetUniqueCap`.
   - Replace them with random sets using new unique items to reach the cap.

**Key principle:** Total number of sets never changes; only uniqueness does.

---

### 💥 New Mechanic: The Nuke (Replaces Boss Buster)

- **Builds power** by matching items:
  `NukePower += itemAttackPower × 10% × comboMultiplier`
- **Combo System**:
  - Starts at **1x**.
  - Combo meter fills after each match and **decays** over time.
  - If matched before timeout, combo increases.
  - Decay window shrinks by 0.25s each level (starts at 4.5s).
  - Max achievable combo: 18x.
  - The **next match** receives the combo multiplier shown.

ComboTimeout2x4.5s3x4.25s......18x~0s

- **Minimum power to activate Nuke** = 50.

input.title: PN string: Lapsed 7 days headline -> "Your Squad Needs You Back"
input.description:
String change for the Lapsed 7 days message (DES-317), which is a Go for beta.

Leonard's latest call (Slack, Sep 29): the 'taken over' push reads like we've given up. Make it "Your Squad Needs You Back", body stays.

Strings are hard-coded in `Assets/Scripts/Notifications/NotificationManager.cs` (match3d):
- Current: `WeeklyReminderTitle = "They’ve Taken Over… Can You Stop Them? 😱"`
- New: `WeeklyReminderTitle = "Your Squad Needs You Back"` (emoji optional, they don't count as a different line)
- `WeeklyReminderMessage` (body) unchanged.

This title is used for every weekly lapsed reminder the client schedules (days 7, 14, 21, 28 after the last session). Once it ships, Vincent needs to re-check it on store builds on both iOS and Android.

input.title: Zombie Match Beta Player Messages - Team Note (Oct 1)
input.bodyText:
Zombie Match beta player messages: where we stand (Oct 1, 2025)

Result: 3 Go, 23 Hold, 6 Drop across 32 messages (14 rows from the PNs Beta tab plus 18 asks filed on tickets). Every call, with its ticket, what's missing, audience and final headline, is in the sheet "Zombie Match Beta Player Messages - Calls (Oct 1)" in the same folder. Calls follow the Beta message rule. The Ready/Not Ready and LIVE/WIP columns on the PN sheet were not used.

1. D1 and D7, Sep 15 install cohort week (warehouse: ANALYTICS.GAME_EVENTS.USER_COHORT_RETENTION)
- iOS: 237 installs, D1 31.65%, D7 9.28%
- Android: 103 installs, D1 37.86%, D7 10.68%
For context, the Sep 22 week (D7 just closed): iOS 102 installs, D1 27.45%, D7 11.76%. Android 106 installs, D1 27.36%, D7 10.38%.

2. Lapsed reminders the client schedules, day by day (NotificationManager.cs, match3d main)
Every time the game goes to the background the client clears and reschedules. Days count from the last session and fire at server midnight. The hour doesn't matter for beta, the day does.
- Day 1: Lapsed 1 day, "The Horde Is Growing…" (Go)
- Days 2-6: nothing
- Day 7: Lapsed 7 days, "They've Taken Over… Can You Stop Them?" (Go, headline changes to "Your Squad Needs You Back" via DES-346)
- Day 14: same Lapsed 7 days message again (this is why the Lapsed 14 days ask is a Drop)
- Day 21: same message again
- Day 28: same message again
- Nothing after day 28. Day 3 (DES-342) and day 30 (DES-343) are Holds on test 3 because the client doesn't schedule them.
Reach: none of this goes out unless the player has been through our own permission ask (after level 20, Robert's call for beta) or switched notifications on from settings. The iOS Unity popup at launch doesn't switch anything on.

3. Messages the client already schedules that are still a Hold
- Lives recharged (DES-315), test 6: Vincent passed it on 0.3.127/0.3.40, but on the iOS store build 0.3.49 it didn't arrive after a full refill (two tries, Sep 30), and he took his tick off. It has to land again on both platforms on the current build.
- Finish first mission (DES-318), test 4: it's aimed at players below level 20, and our own permission ask only runs after level 20, so nobody it's written for can get it. Vincent only saw it with notifications switched on from settings, which doesn't count. It stays Hold unless the permission ask moves earlier, which is Robert's call.
- Weekly Leaderboard reset (DES-320), test 5: the client fires it 7/14/21/28 days after the player's last session. The weekly reset comes from the server's league end date, so the message lands on the wrong day unless the player happened to last play on reset day. It has to be scheduled off the league end date.

4. Go list (on the Push Notifications card checklist for Vincent)
- Lapsed 1 day: "The Horde Is Growing…" (no string change)
- Lapsed 7 days: "Your Squad Needs You Back" (string change DES-346, needs a re-check after it ships)
- Plague Race: "Plague Race Is On!" (no string change, daily for players past level 26)

5. What happened to the rest
- Drop (6): Hourly Coins, Nathan's Treasure Hunt, Streak Fever and Axe Arena (none of these features is live in Zombie Match or on the BETA list), Comeback gift on tap (v2, not in beta), Lapsed 14 days (already covered by Lapsed 7 days on day 14).
- Hold on test 2, needs a server send (6): Endless weekly result, Season Pass premium nudge, Plague Race result, Support reply waiting, New levels added. Lapsed 3/30 and the rest below are local.
- Hold on test 3, the client doesn't schedule them yet but a local timer can (14): Quests rollover, Win & Collect start, Login Calendar update, Season Pass start, Endless entries back, Boss Arena open, Boss Arena last hours, Season Pass last 48h, Plague Race last hour, Zombie Lane reward, Achievement reward, Daily chest, Free shop coins, Lapsed 3 days, Lapsed 30 days.
Held tickets are in Backlog and unassigned, per the BETA list rule on the ZM ROADMAP board. Dropped tickets are Canceled.

input.body:
Hi Brian,

I've gone through every beta phone message against Leonard's Beta message rule. Here's where your four asks landed:

- Endless entries are back (DES-328): Hold. Endless is live and entries refill on a timer, so it can be sent locally, but the client doesn't schedule it yet (test 3).
- Endless weekly result (DES-329): Hold. It needs a server send because the phone doesn't know the final standings (test 2).
- Season Pass premium nudge (DES-333): Hold. It needs a server send because it's picked per player from server data (test 2).
- Comeback gift on tap (DES-345): Drop. A reward on tap is a version 2 idea and isn't in the beta (test 1).

Held tickets are in Backlog, unassigned, until the beta build is out. The dropped one is Canceled. Each ticket has the reasoning in a comment.

Thanks,
Samuel

content.text:
I've finished everything in Leonard's DM and sent him the counts there ([message](https://harmonygamesgroup.slack.com/archives/D06L58XCVKK/p1759302520000000)). Of the 32 messages (14 rows on the PNs Beta tab plus 18 asks filed on tickets), 3 are Go, 23 are Hold and 6 are Drop. I found no new-message asks filed on Trello cards.

**Go (3):**
- Lapsed 1 day.
- Lapsed 7 days. Leonard asked on Sep 29 for the headline to become "Your Squad Needs You Back". The client still ships the old line, so I opened string ticket DES-346.
- Plague Race.

The PN sheet marked six as Ready. The three that didn't make it are already scheduled by the client but are Holds:
- **Lives recharged:** Vincent took his tick off after it didn't arrive on the iOS 0.3.49 store build on Sep 30.
- **Finish first mission:** it's for players below level 20, but our own permission ask only runs after level 20 (Robert's call), so none of them can get it.
- **Weekly Leaderboard:** it fires 7 days after the player's last session, not on the server's weekly reset day.

**Drop (6):** Hourly Coins, Treasure Hunt, Streak Fever and Axe Arena (none of these is in Zombie Match or on the BETA list), Comeback gift (Leonard says it's v2), and Lapsed 14 days (the client already sends the 7-day reminder again on day 14).

The other 20 Holds are either local messages the client doesn't schedule yet (15) or ones that need a server to send them (5). The sheet has the reason for each one.

**What's where:**
- **Drive folder:** the sheet "Zombie Match Beta Player Messages - Calls (Oct 1)" and the note "Zombie Match Beta Player Messages - Team Note (Oct 1)". The note gives D1/D7 for the Sep 15 cohort week (iOS 31.65% / 9.28%, Android 37.86% / 10.68%), the lapsed reminders by day (day 1, then days 7, 14, 21, 28), and the three Holds above.
- **Push notifications card:** a checklist with the 3 Go messages for Vincent.
- **Tickets:** every ticket has its call as a comment. Drops are Canceled and Gos are unchanged. Holds went to Backlog, unassigned, not Todo. The rule doc says Todo "unless the roadmap says otherwise", and the beta card on the ZM ROADMAP board says held tickets sit in Backlog, unassigned.
- **No new message tickets:** the one sheet row without a DES-314 ticket, Win & Collect, already had DES-313 from Calvin. DES-346 is the only ticket I created, and it's a string change.
- **Emails:** sent to the 7 people who asked (Brian, Robert, Oliver, Julia, Owen, Calvin, Martin). Leonard wasn't emailed, as he asked.

Two calls rest on my reading of the code. If either is wrong it would change a call:
- **Weekly Leaderboard:** the Hold is based on how the client schedules it, not on anything Vincent saw. He passed it by moving the phone date forward.
- **Free shop coins:** I treated it as a live feature separate from Hourly Coins. If it's actually the same thing, that ticket should be a Drop rather than a Hold.
